Each hour: time, direction and speed (knots, g = gust), odds of 12kt or more, regime, waves, tide height in ft with r rising or f falling. OUTFLOW NOT RIDDEN = Squamish outflow, never recommend. OFF DIR = direction does not work at that spot.
Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Tue, Nov 10 7:40am to 6:12pm; Wed, Nov 11 7:42am to 6:11pm; Thu, Nov 12 7:43am to 6:09pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Tue, Nov 10 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): The Fraser easterly is on and Point Atkinson is running ahead of the page, E 21 at 6am and 19 gusting 24 at 7am, so Erwin Park should see about 15 to 17 against the page's 14. That's my pick, from first light (about 7:45am) until about 5:30pm, no tide limit, and Environment Canada calls southeast 20 to 30 this afternoon. Check before driving: Point Atkinson 18 or more from the east, go. I'm skipping Tsawwassen, where the last rider report had lots of weeds, and Boundary Bay, which likely has the same after these southeast storms. Jericho is the backup, buoy ENE 12 gusting 15.
